items.title: Managing Tourism in the Lake District | GCSE Geography Revision
items.description: Covers the impacts of 15.8 million annual visitors and how the National Park manages footpath erosion, traffic, and conservation conflicts.

items.title: L5 Tourism in the Lake District - AQA GCSE Revision
items.description: Dedicated AQA GCSE revision lesson on tourism's economic, social, and environmental impacts in the Lake District.

items.title: GCSE Geography - Lake District Case Study (Seneca)
items.description: Examines conflicts between tourists, farmers, quarry operators, and conservationists over land use in the Lake District.

items.title: GCSEPod Geography - Landscape Management in the Lake District
items.description: Looks at strategies used by the Lake District National Park to balance economic activity with environmental protection.

items.title: The Lakes with Paul Rose (2018)
items.description: Meets the farmers, fell runners, and conservationists whose livelihoods depend on managing the Lake District National Park.

items.title: Wainwright Walks (2007)
items.description: BBC series tracing Wainwright's Lake District routes, highlighting the landscape that draws millions of tourists each year.

items.title: Planet Earth II (2016)
items.description: Illustrates why upland environments like the Lake District are ecologically important and face pressure from tourism and development.

items.title: The Lake District: A Wild Year (2016)
items.description: Documents the wild landscapes that make the Lake District the UK's most-visited National Park and the conservation challenges this creates.

items.title: Life of a Mountain: A Year on Scafell Pike (2014)
items.description: Follows farmers, climbers, and conservationists whose activities and conflicts mirror the case study themes for this lesson.

items.title: Tourism in an Upland Glaciated Area: The Lake District - Internet Geography
items.description: AQA GCSE notes on visitor numbers, economic benefits, environmental impacts, and management strategies in the Lake District.

items.title: Economic Activities in Glaciated Upland Areas - Internet Geography
items.description: Covers farming, forestry, quarrying, and tourism in glaciated uplands with UK examples including the Lake District.

items.title: Lake District Tourism - Coolgeography
items.description: GCSE revision resource on the social, economic, and environmental impacts of tourism with data on visitor numbers and management schemes.

items.title: Conflicts in Glacial Landscapes - Seneca Learning AQA GCSE
items.description: Free interactive revision notes on conflicts between tourists, farmers, quarry operators, and conservationists in glaciated uplands.

items.title: GCSE Geography - Economic Uses of Glaciated Areas (Seneca Learning)
items.description: Podcast episode covering farming, forestry, quarrying, and tourism in glaciated landscapes, plus the conflicts and management strategies that arise.
